implementation_strategy: Execute confirmatory paired design exactly via the hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter using model gpt-5-mini on the hosted API. For each of the 600 predeclared task_indices (deterministically produced by the adapter profile), (1) make one shared initial generation call (baseline candidate), record runtime sampling parameters; (2) run deterministic semantic validators; (3) if validator fails, invoke at most one guarded repair call per adapter rules; (4) rerun validators; (5) record final validator pass/fail. All scoring and validator logic are deterministic and autonomous per the adapter contract; no human labour is used. Total model calls bounded at task_count*2=1200; stop when all predeclared indices processed or model-call budget exhausted. Runtime logs, raw outputs, validator traces, and hashes archived for reproducibility.
public_resources: Evidence records listed in preregistration (public DOIs/URLs)
task_manifest_strategy: Deterministic selection via hosted_netops_gvr_v1 challenging_workflow_stress_v1 index rule; only public-licensed redistributable items included after automated provenance checks; flagged items excluded from primary confirmatory analysis per contamination_plan.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Use adapter-declared transformations: baseline=direct_configuration_generation_v1; guarded=generate_validate_repair_v1 with deterministic validators and at most one automatic repair attempt per failing validation.
execution_batches: Single execution batch: process 600 task_indices sequentially in deterministic order derived from the adapter index rule; model calls issued as needed up to 1200 calls.
randomisation_plan: No randomisation for task selection (deterministic adapter rule). Runtime generation sampling parameters recorded but not used for selection; no outcome-dependent stopping.
caching_plan: Cache none beyond deterministic archival of raw model responses and validator outputs; reuse cached initial generation when needed across paired conditions per shared_initial_candidate semantics.
failure_recovery_plan: Technical model-call failures logged with timestamps and locations; primary analysis excludes pairs with technical failures per missingness_plan ('complete_pair_primary'); automated re-execution not attempted beyond adapter-allowed single attempt per call. Sensitivity analysis treats technical failures as semantic failures.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1 v1.0 (validator pass/fail per episode, shared_initial_candidate linkage, per-call metadata, task_index)
estimated_compute_notes: Total model calls = task_count * 2 = 600 * 2 = 1200 (worst-case: all tasks require a guarded repair). All calls via hosted API (gpt-5-mini); no local GPU required. Wall-clock execution feasible within capability manifest limits (≤7 days) given minimal per-call reasoning effort and single repair attempt policy.
